Name: OrangePie's DCBurger style Wizard and Marlon Portraits
Author: OrangePieUwU
Description:
High res portraits of Wizard and Marlon, Since I use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4745]DCBurger's Portrait[/url] for the main game I tried to draw in style that fits with DCBurger's portrait. Compatible with most mods that make those 2 characters romanceable (also with vanilla game ).


*Make sure you have PyTK mod (https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1726)*
[b][size=4]PYTK unofficial update for 1.5.5: [url=https://forums.stardewvalley.net/threads/unofficial-mod-updates.2096/page-78#post-53000]https://forums.stardewvalley.net/threads/unofficial-mod-updates.2096/page-78#post-53000[/url]﻿[/size][/b]

For the wizard, I personally recommend [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3073]Romanceable Rasmodius[/url] mod made by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/2421870]WerewolfMaster[/url], as I think it has the best writing among all wizard romance mod, but the portraits should be compatible with [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10206]Looking For Love[/url][/b] too, and I made a different version for people who have Stardrew valley expanded and would like to use my portrait for SVE wizard.

I made a CP version that should work for everyone (with a different CP file for people who have SVE since SVE wizard emote is different).

And for people who have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4745]DCBurger's Portrait[/url] mod or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9029]lunakatt's DCBurger Style Portraits for SVE[/url] mod (or just SVE mod), there's also the replacement file version. The replacement file version prevents assets from getting loaded two times and prevents 2Dtexture Error in some situation. Choose whichever version you prefer/whichever version works for you. Check [b]readme.txt[/b] in the folder for details.

For people who use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3073]Romanceable Rasmodius[/url] mod, remember to turn the nine expression setting on for full experience.



For Marlon, ﻿I personally recommend [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7018]Make Marlon Real[/url] mod (also made by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/2421870]WerewolfMaster[/url]). 

I also made a CP version for him, and replacement files for people who have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4745]DCBurger's Portrait[/url] mod or SVE mod. The replacement file version prevents assets from getting loaded two times and prevents 2Dtexture Error in some situation. Choose whichever version you prefer/whichever version works for you. Check [b]readme.txt[/b] in the folder for details.


And Portraiture version for them both, I've never used Portraiture, so please let me know if the portraits doesn't work.



The original art style belongs to DCBurger: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/66555116]tryptan[/url], please go give them Endorsements and loves.
Please also go give love to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/2421870]WerewolfMaster[/url] for conquering the unobtainables xD.
